String.string:
[EN] You see Lok ahead of you.
[ES] Ves a Lok adelante.

[EN] Corrupted Guardians are blocking the way.
[ES] Los guardianes corruptos están bloqueando el camino.

[EN] Thulsa and the mysterious woman created a barrier.
[ES] Thulsa y la mujer misteriosa crearon una barrera.

[EN] Thulsa’s barrier is gone.
[ES] La barrera de Thulsa ha desapareció.

[EN] Fallen guardians block your path.
[ES] Los guardianes caídos bloquean tu camino.

[EN] Defeat the converging Guardians.
[ES] Derrota a los guardianes convergentes.

[EN] Defeat the Guardians coming from the right side.
[ES] Derrota a los guardianes que vienen del lado derecho.

[EN] Thulsa’s barrier has disappeared.
Head to where Thulsa was located.
[ES] La barrera de Thulsa ha desaparecido.
Dirígete a donde estaba Thulsa.

[EN] All the Guardians are straying from their calling...
[ES] Todos los guardianes se están desvían de su vocación...

[EN] I won’t forget this.
[ES] No olvidaré esto.

[EN] Things are getting annoying.
[ES] Las cosas se están poniendo molestas.

[EN] Thulsa stole titanic essense from the Tower of Shara.
[ES] Thulsa robó la esencia titánica de la Tower of Shara.

[EN] What he needs it for is not clear yet, but I'm sure he's up to no good.
[ES] No está claro para qué la necesita aún, pero seguro que trama algo malo.

[EN] It must be retrieved before it's too late.
[ES] Hay que recuperarla antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

[EN] Let's talk on the way. Follow me.
[ES] Hablemos por el camino. Sígome.
